description: Source code for Samsung's OpenMAX IL video decoder component (SEC_OMX_Vdec.c), including buffer management, parameter handling, component initialization, and processing functions for video decoding on Samsung devices.

methods.name: SEC_UpdateFrameSize
methods.description: Updates output port frame size and buffer size based on input port parameters.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_UseBuffer
methods.description: Handles user-allocated buffer setup for a port.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates memory buffers for a port.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_FreeBuffer
methods.description: Frees allocated buffers for a port.

methods.name: SEC_Check_BufferProcess_State
methods.description: Checks if buffer processing can proceed based on component state.

methods.name: SEC_InputBufferReturn
methods.description: Returns input buffer to the component after processing.

methods.name: SEC_BufferReset
methods.description: Resets buffer state for a given port.

methods.name: SEC_DataReset
methods.description: Resets process data for a port.

methods.name: SEC_Preprocessor_InputData
methods.description: Prepares input data for decoding, handling EOF and buffer copying.

methods.name: SEC_Postprocess_OutputData
methods.description: Prepares output data for delivery, handling timestamps and buffer copying.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_BufferProcess
methods.description: Main buffer processing loop, managing input/output buffers and decoding.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_VideoDecodeGetParameter
methods.description: Retrieves decoder parameters such as port formats and bitrate.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_VideoDecodeSetParameter
methods.description: Sets decoder parameters such as port formats and bitrate.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_VideoDecodeComponentInit
methods.description: Initializes the video decoder component, setting up ports and function pointers.

methods.name: SEC_OMX_VideoDecodeComponentDeinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the decoder component, freeing resources.
